<div class="review-text">
Cheap slop that copies the form of what it tries to imitate, but not the function.<br>
Game moves at a snail's pace, broken up by about 50% Freddy Fish puzzles, and 50% random location-based story triggers. Lots of gory shock art too, which was annoying. And don't come hoping for a mystery, there's no internal consistency to be found here.<br>
I appreciate that it was fully voice acted and all, and the art was *technically* proficient, but that's about the end of the nice things I have to say about it.
</div>
